thread:
emma: Heads up — I'm starting a proposal to remove the REST shim for internal backends and route proto directly through our edge (envoy -> gRPC). Proposal doc: https://redwood/docs/internal/proto-routing (WIP). Main open questions: quota mapping, dashboard continuity, rollout UX for surfaced clients. Thoughts?
kevin: @emma big +1 on removing shim. We get less translation bugs. Concern: how do we map existing quota keys? many customers rely on route -> quota `api.v1.foo`.
priya: We can keep a compatibility layer in control-plane: map REST paths to proto method names for billing/console. That keeps telemetry names stable while removing shim in dataplane.
dmitri: That sounds ok but has operational complexity. If control-plane mapping fails clients lose metrics. Suggest we also emit legacy metric names from runtime for a transition window.
Example envoy config snippet I tried:
```yaml
- name: envoy.filters.http.grpc_web
  config: {}
- name: envoy.filters.http.grpc_json_transcoder
  config:
    proto_descriptor: /etc/protos/api.pb
    services: ["api.v1.Service"]
```
This still adds CPU overhead.
kevin: If we emit both names we can use rollout flags in console to switch dashboards. Need to add `metric_alias` support in console (per-route) and ability to hide legacy names after N days.
emma: @dmitri do we have perf numbers for the transcoder vs direct grpc on our smallest instance? I want to include perf delta in the RFC.
dmitri: Quick bench on g4dn.xlarge: transcoder + JSON -> gRPC adds ~18-25% p95 latency for 512B payloads, tokenizing costs spike on big payloads. Direct grpc is ~3-5ms p95 lower.
priya: For quotas: propose mapping heuristic + opt-in header `X-Rw-Compat: legacy` that the control-plane can use to route quota lookups. During canary we set header on 10% to collect signal.
kevin: Rollout UX: console should show 'compat traffic' stack in per-route panel with toggle. Also a canary timeline with failure rate / latency per cohort. We need to tie rollout signals to automatic rollback policy (if error rate > 1% for 10m).
emma: Agreed. Also need a migration checklist for clients: proto stubs, TLS requirements, and note about HTTP/2. We'll add a migration tracker in the console.
deploy-bot: deploy started: proto-routing-canary v0.1 -> infra/canary-3. Linked PR: https://gh/redwood/proto-routing/pull/245
srebot: Alert: canary bucket 'proto-routing-canary' saw 1.3% 5xx in last 5m. Added to dashboard under 'canary/alerts'. @emma @kevin
emma: :thinking_face: Revert config on canary then? @dmitri can you check logs and see if charset/transcoder error?
dmitri: Looking. Stack shows `json_transcoder: unknown_field` from a client sending extra fields. We should add a 'lenient' parsing mode or accept unknown fields during transition.
priya: We can set json_transcoder option `ignore_unknown_fields: true` in envoy config for the canary traffic only.
emma: Plan: pause canary, push lenient parsing, re-run 5% for 1 hour, monitor quota mapping+dashboard. I'll update RFC with runbook and console check widgets. Thanks all.
